asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

defaultStep.description:
The initial value of the stepper when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the stepper.

ids.description: The custom ids for the stepper elements

isStepSkippable.description:
Whether a step can be skipped during navigation.
Skippable steps are bypassed when using next/prev.

isStepValid.description: Whether a step is valid. Invalid steps block forward navigation in linear mode.

linear.description: If `true`, the stepper requires the user to complete the steps in order

onStepChange.description: Callback to be called when the value changes

onStepComplete.description: Callback to be called when a step is completed

onStepInvalid.description: Called when navigation is blocked due to an invalid step.
